item.title: Bridging Innovation and Technology Transfer, Ethics, and Social Responsibility: Multi-Level Approaches
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites research examining the interconnections between innovation, technology transfer, ethical considerations, and social responsibility across multiple organizational and societal levels. The collection seeks to understand how technological advancement can be effectively managed while maintaining ethical standards and fulfilling social obligations.

Appel publié par Technology in Society. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

  • September 30, 2026: Submission deadline

item.title: Socially Responsible Urban Freight Transport
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of Research in Transportation Business & Management focuses on socially responsible approaches to urban freight transport. The issue seeks to explore how freight operations in urban environments can balance economic efficiency with social and environmental considerations.

Appel publié par Research in Transportation Business & Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

item.title: Responsible Retail Operations
item.content:encoded:
Jan C. Fransoo, Tilburg University

Dorothee Honhon, University of Texas at Dallas

Appel publié par Manufacturing & Service Operations Management. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Waste in food, apparel and electronics retail
  • Labor conditions in stores and delivery operations
  • Carbon emissions generated by highly responsive online or on-demand retail operations
  • The role of retail stores in the livability of rural communities
  • The presence of food deserts and food banks in low-income urban communities
  • The subsistence role of retail stores in developing countries and communities
  • Data privacy concerns such as face recognition in stores or data tracking online

Timeline

  • January 1, 2025: Deadline for confidential extended abstract scope check submissions
  • August 1, 2025: Deadline for submissions
  • November 1, 2025: First-round decisions and feedback
  • May 1, 2026: Second-round submission for papers invited to revise
  • September 1, 2026: Final decisions subject to minor revisions
